blocks.word: Style: Normal. Select only the word HIDDEN and apply Format > Font > Hidden.
blocks.expectation: Hidden text never pastes, as Word does not show it. Chrome and Firefox carry Word's raw HTML, which keeps the word in a run Word hides (display:none with mso-hide:all): cleanup leaves the run out and reports hidden-text-removed. Safari leaves the word out of the copy and nothing in it tells of hidden text, so nothing is reported.
blocks.correction: Records what Word copies per browser, which the captures show. On the owner's decision of 2026-10-05 the hidden word no longer pastes visible with unsupported-formatting; it is left out with a warning of its own.
